worker.about: Report, submit a PR or read context as the current helper session
worker.failed: Helper access failed: check session credentials, connectivity and operation authorization
worker.report: Report as the current session. JSON requires summary (string). Optional: prSubmit (boolean, default false; true needs explicit owner authorization), questions (question string, options string array), checks (criterion zero-based number, result met/unmet/unsure, proof string), remember (text string, scope repo/all), answer (conclusion string, evidence/next/unsure string arrays). Omitted arrays default to empty. Credentials bind identity; arguments cannot select another session.
worker.pr: Submit the current session PR with explicit owner authorization. JSON accepts optional summary string.
worker.context: Read the current issue thread. Optional JSON fields: id (channel/thread), before (message number), limit (count), unread (boolean).
worker.read: Read a context resource. JSON requires uri (vv:// resource address). Optional offset and limit (integers).
worker.doctor: Authenticate a read-only session_list call to check credentials and tool access; this does not prove the coding agent loaded optional MCP. JSON defaults to an empty object.
worker.json: Tool input as a JSON object; see the command description for fields.
